title: [2.7] Feature Request: Add Battery Age, Canula Age and Remaining Glucose to Automation
body:
Hi,

I would like to use AAPS Automation do show me a notification when 

- Battery age is older than n days
- Canula age is older than n days
- Remaining glucose in cartridge is less than n IE

and this info I'd like to receive during daytime only.

Automation would be a perfect tool if the three triggers were available.

Could you add them?

thank you,
Arne

comments.body: I would like to add also Battery level into this list. However, I must agree that all these can also looked after quite well with Status lights in the main screen.

In principle true, compared to the previous AAPS versions the main menu display in 2.7 is a big step ahead, but still can be overlooked quite easily. My preference would be a notification you actively need to confirm.

setting tresholds and use colors is enough from my point of view
if you you watch the screen you'll see it. if not, notification doesn't help much
